e: Everybody attracts every other body in the universe. The physics in this sentence is built around every other body.

q: The gravitational force between the two bodies is directly proportional to the product of the masses and ____ between them.
c: inversely proportional to the square of the distance
e: The gravitational force between the two bodies is directly proportional to the product of the masses and inversely proportional to the square of the distance between them. Inversely proportional to the square of the distance here means the path length travelled, with no direction. Gravity pulls every mass toward every other mass, weaker as r squared grows.
In symbols, $F \propto \frac{m_1 m_2}{r^2}$. The physics in this sentence is built around $F \propto \frac{m_1 m_2}{r^2}$.

q: According to experimental measurements the value of G in MKS system is found to be ____.
e: According to experimental measurements the value of G in MKS system is found to be $6.67 \times 10^{-11} \text{ m}^3 \text{kg}^{-1} \text{s}^{-2}$. You compare the unknown amount with a standard so the result is a number with a unit.

q: where G is a ____ which is the same for all bodies in the universe.
e: Where G is a constant which is the same for all bodies in the universe. Constant here means a quantity that does not change, not the agreed measuring unit.

q: The attractions of the moon and the sun upon water of the earth cause ____.
e: The attractions of the moon and the sun upon water of the earth cause tides. The physics in this sentence is built around tides.

q: Satellites are kept in their circular orbit by the ____ of the earth.
e: Satellites are kept in their circular orbit by the gravitational attraction of the earth. The physics in this sentence is built around gravitational attraction.
